MINT_RECEIVER_POLICY().details: Unlike the transfer-side policies, this slot is ALWAYS enforced — including for      factory-originated mints during the creation (bootstrap) window — so new supply is never      issued to a policy-denied recipient even at creation. See `IB20Factory.createB20`.

SEIZE_EXEMPT_POLICY().details: A `from` is seizable only when `isAuthorized(policyId, from)` returns false.This uses the inverse of the normal transfer-style gating: accounts are seizable when      `isAuthorized(...)` returns false, not true.An unset slot reads as `0` (always-allow), so every account is seize-exempt until an issuer      explicitly configures the slot.

SEIZE_RECEIVER_POLICY().details: Mirrors `MINT_RECEIVER_POLICY`: always enforced on the seize destination. An unset slot reads      as `0` (always-allow), so seize may send anywhere until an issuer configures the slot.

TRANSFER_EXECUTOR_POLICY().details: Bypassed for factory-originated calls during the creation (bootstrap) window; see      `IB20Factory.createB20`.

TRANSFER_RECEIVER_POLICY().details: Bypassed for factory-originated calls during the creation (bootstrap) window; see      `IB20Factory.createB20`.

TRANSFER_SENDER_POLICY().details: Bypassed for factory-originated calls during the creation (bootstrap) window; see      `IB20Factory.createB20`.

announce(bytes[],string,string,string).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `OPERATOR_ROLE`.Reverts with `AnnouncementIdAlreadyUsed` when `id` has previously been consumed.Reverts with `InternalCallMalformed` when an entry in `internalCalls` is shorter than four bytes.Reverts with `AnnouncementInProgress` when an entry in `internalCalls` targets `announce` itself.An inner call that raises a Solidity `Panic` (e.g. arithmetic overflow) propagates the      raw Panic unchanged; any other inner revert wraps as `InternalCallFailed(call)`. An inner      out-of-gas halts the whole call.

params.id: Caller-chosen announcement id; single-use over the token's lifetime.
params.internalCalls: ABI-encoded calldata blobs executed in order via self-`delegatecall`; may be empty.
params.uri: Off-chain URI containing the full announcement contents.

approve(address,uint256).details: Reverts with `InvalidApprover` when `msg.sender == address(0)`.Reverts with `InvalidSpender` when `spender == address(0)`.

params.account: Account whose balance is being queried.
Account whose UI-adjusted balance is being queried.

batchMint(address[],uint256[]).details: Reverts with `ContractPaused(MINT)` when `MINT` is paused.Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `MINT_ROLE`.Reverts with `LengthMismatch` when `recipients.length != amounts.length`.Reverts with `EmptyBatch` when either array is empty.Reverts with `InvalidReceiver` when any `recipients[i] == address(0)`.Reverts with `PolicyForbids(MINT_RECEIVER_POLICY, ...)` when any recipient is not authorized.Reverts with `SupplyCapExceeded` when the cumulative mint would exceed the cap.

burn(uint256).details: Reverts with `ContractPaused(BURN)` when `BURN` is paused.Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `BURN_ROLE`.Reverts with `InsufficientBalance` when the caller's balance is below `amount`.

burnBlocked(address,uint256).details: Gated by `BURN_BLOCKED_ROLE` and the `BURN` pause vector (not `SEIZE`). Its blocked check      reads `TRANSFER_SENDER_POLICY`, distinct from `seizeWithMemo`'s `SEIZE_EXEMPT_POLICY`.Reverts with `ContractPaused(BURN)` when `BURN` is paused.Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `BURN_BLOCKED_ROLE`.Reverts with `AccountNotBlocked` when `from` is currently authorized under `TRANSFER_SENDER_POLICY`.Reverts with `InsufficientBalance` when `from`'s balance is below `amount`.

params.from: Account whose blocked balance is being burned.

cancelUIMultiplierUpdate().details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `OPERATOR_ROLE`.Reverts with `UIMultiplierUpdateDoesNotExist` when there is no live pending update.

returns._0: Current value, or the empty string.
Raw token amount at the effective multiplier.

params.role: Role whose admin is being queried.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold the admin role for `role`,      or when the token has been transitioned to admin-less via `renounceLastAdmin` (admin-resurrection guard).

mint(address,uint256).details: Reverts with `ContractPaused(MINT)` when `MINT` is paused.Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `MINT_ROLE`.Reverts with `InvalidReceiver` when `to == address(0)`.Reverts with `PolicyForbids(MINT_RECEIVER_POLICY, ...)` when `to` is not authorized.Reverts with `SupplyCapExceeded` when `totalSupply + amount > supplyCap`.

params.owner: Account whose nonce is being queried.

pause(uint8[]).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `PAUSE_ROLE`.Reverts with `EmptyFeatureSet` when `features.length == 0`.

permit(address,address,uint256,uint256,u.details: Reverts with `ExpiredSignature` when `block.timestamp > deadline`.Reverts with `InvalidSigner` when ECDSA recovery does not yield `owner`.Reverts with `InvalidSpender` when `spender == address(0)`.

params.deadline: Unix timestamp after which the signature is invalid.

policyId(bytes32).details: Reverts with `UnsupportedPolicyType` when `policyScope` is not recognized by this token.

renounceLastAdmin().details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when `msg.sender` does not hold `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`.Reverts with `NotSoleAdmin` when other accounts also hold `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Reverts with `AccessControlBadConfirmation` when `callerConfirmation != msg.sender`.Reverts with `LastAdminCannotRenounce` when `role == DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` and the caller is the last default admin.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold the admin role for `role`,      or when the token has been transitioned to admin-less via `renounceLastAdmin`.Reverts with `LastAdminCannotRenounce` when `role == DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` and `account` is the last default admin.      Use `renounceLastAdmin` to clear the final admin.

params.account: Account whose scaled balance is being queried.

seizeWithMemo(address,address,uint256,by.details: Admin operation: skips allowance and the transfer policies. The membership checks are that      `from` is not authorized under `SEIZE_EXEMPT_POLICY` and `to` is authorized under `SEIZE_RECEIVER_POLICY`.`to` is gated by `SEIZE_RECEIVER_POLICY`, which defaults to always-allow when unset, so an      unconfigured token may seize to any destination (a treasury need not be allowlisted).Reverts with `ContractPaused(SEIZE)` when `SEIZE` is paused.Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `SEIZE_ROLE`.Reverts with `InvalidReceiver` when `to == address(0)` or `from == to`.Reverts with `InvalidSender` when `from == address(0)`.Reverts with `AccountNotSeizable` when `from` is authorized under `SEIZE_EXEMPT_POLICY`.Reverts with `PolicyForbids(SEIZE_RECEIVER_POLICY, ...)` when `to` is not authorized under `SEIZE_RECEIVER_POLICY`.Reverts with `InsufficientBalance` when `from`'s balance is below `amount`.

params.from: Account whose balance is being seized.
params.to: Destination address for the seized balance.

setRoleAdmin(bytes32,bytes32).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold the current admin role for `role`,      or when the token has been transitioned to admin-less via `renounceLastAdmin`.

params.role: Role whose admin is being updated.

toRawBalance(uint256).details: Integer division rounds toward zero; conversions are not exactly reversible when      `multiplier != WAD_PRECISION`. `toRawBalance(toScaledBalance(x))` may return a      value slightly less than `x`.

params.scaledBalance: Scaled token amount to convert back.

returns.rawBalance: Raw balance at the current multiplier.

returns._0: Scaled balance at the current multiplier.
UI amount at the effective multiplier.

transfer(address,uint256).details: Reverts with `ContractPaused(TRANSFER)` when `TRANSFER` is paused.Reverts with `InvalidReceiver` when `to == address(0)`.Reverts with `InvalidSender` when `msg.sender == address(0)`.Reverts with `PolicyForbids(TRANSFER_SENDER_POLICY, ...)` when `msg.sender` is not authorized.Reverts with `PolicyForbids(TRANSFER_RECEIVER_POLICY, ...)` when `to` is not authorized.Reverts with `InsufficientBalance` when `msg.sender`'s balance is below `amount`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Reverts with `ContractPaused(TRANSFER)` when `TRANSFER` is paused.Reverts with `InvalidReceiver` when `to == address(0)`.Reverts with `InvalidSender` when `from == address(0)`.Reverts with `InsufficientAllowance` when the caller's allowance from `from` is below `amount`.Reverts with `PolicyForbids(TRANSFER_EXECUTOR_POLICY, ...)` when `msg.sender != from` and `msg.sender` is not authorized.Reverts with `PolicyForbids(TRANSFER_SENDER_POLICY, ...)` when `from` is not authorized.Reverts with `PolicyForbids(TRANSFER_RECEIVER_POLICY, ...)` when `to` is not authorized.Reverts with `InsufficientBalance` when `from`'s balance is below `amount`.

unpause(uint8[]).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `UNPAUSE_ROLE`.Reverts with `EmptyFeatureSet` when `features.length == 0`.

updateContractURI(string).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `METADATA_ROLE`.

updateExtraMetadata(string,string).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `METADATA_ROLE`.Reverts with `InvalidMetadataKey` when `key` is the empty string.

params.value: New value, or empty string to remove.

updateMultiplier(uint256).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `OPERATOR_ROLE`.Reverts with `InvalidMultiplier` when `newMultiplier` is zero or above `type(uint128).max`.

params.newMultiplier: New multiplier scaled to `WAD_PRECISION`; must be in `(0, type(uint128).max]`.

updateName(string).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `METADATA_ROLE`.

updatePolicy(bytes32,uint64).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`.Reverts with `UnsupportedPolicyType` when `policyScope` is not recognized by this token.Reverts with `PolicyNotFound` when `newPolicyId` is not a built-in sentinel and does not exist in the registry.

params.newPolicyId: Policy ID to assign to the slot.

updateSupplyCap(uint256).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`.Reverts with `InvalidSupplyCap` when `newSupplyCap < totalSupply()` or `newSupplyCap > type(uint128).max`.

params.newSupplyCap: New supply cap. Must not exceed `type(uint128).max`.

updateSymbol(string).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `METADATA_ROLE`.

updateUIMultiplier(uint256,uint256).details: Reverts with `AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount` when the caller does not hold `OPERATOR_ROLE`.Reverts with `InvalidMultiplier` when `newMultiplier` is zero or above `type(uint128).max`.Reverts with `EffectiveAtInPast` when `effectiveAt` is not in the future.Reverts with `EffectiveAtTooFar` when `effectiveAt` exceeds `type(uint64).max`.Reverts with `UIMultiplierUpdateExists` when a live pending update already exists.

params.effectiveAt: Timestamp at which `newMultiplier` becomes effective; must be in the future.

DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE().notice: The default top-level admin role (`bytes32(0)`). Required to call `grantRole`, `revokeRole`,         `setRoleAdmin`, `updatePolicy`, and `updateSupplyCap`.

DOMAIN_SEPARATOR().notice: The current EIP-712 domain separator for this token. Recomputed on each call so it         remains correct after `updateName` or a chain fork that changes `block.chainid`.

MAX_UI_MULTIPLIER().notice: The maximum multiplier the setters accept: `type(uint128).max`, the overflow guard.         Exposed so callers can read the bound without triggering the `InvalidMultiplier`         revert path. With supply capped at `type(uint128).max`, a `uint128` multiplier keeps         `balance * multiplier` inside `uint256`.

MINT_RECEIVER_POLICY().notice: Policy slot consulted against `to` on every mint.

OPERATOR_ROLE().notice: Required to call `announce`, `updateUIMultiplier`, `cancelUIMultiplierUpdate`, and         `updateUIMultiplier`. The metadata setters (`updateName`, `updateSymbol`,         `updateExtraMetadata`) are gated by the inherited `METADATA_ROLE` instead.

SEIZE_EXEMPT_POLICY().notice: Policy slot consulted against `from` by `seizeWithMemo`. An authorized account is seize-exempt.

TRANSFER_EXECUTOR_POLICY().notice: Policy slot consulted against `msg.sender` on `transferFrom` when distinct from `from`.         Not consulted on `transfer`.

TRANSFER_RECEIVER_POLICY().notice: Policy slot consulted against `to` on every transfer.

TRANSFER_SENDER_POLICY().notice: Policy slot consulted against `from` on every transfer (including `transferFrom`).

WAD_PRECISION().notice: Fixed-point precision used to scale `multiplier`. Equal to `1e18`.

announce(bytes[],string,string,string).notice: Posts a holder-impacting announcement and atomically dispatches each entry in         `internalCalls` via self-`delegatecall` (preserving `msg.sender`). Emits         `Announcement` then `EndAnnouncement` with the same `id`. Pass an empty         `internalCalls` for a pure disclosure.

approve(address,uint256).notice: Sets `spender`'s allowance to `amount`. Not gated by any policy or by pause. Emits `Approval`.

balanceOfUI(address).notice: Returns the UI-adjusted balance of an account.

batchMint(address[],uint256[]).notice: Mints `amounts[i]` to `recipients[i]` in one call. All-or-nothing: any element         revert unwinds the whole transaction. Emits `Transfer(address(0), recipients[i], amounts[i])`         per element.

burn(uint256).notice: Burns `amount` from the caller's own balance. Not subject to any policy.         Emits `Transfer(caller, address(0), amount)`.

burnBlocked(address,uint256).notice: DEPRECATED. Burns `amount` from a `from` account that is blocked under         `TRANSFER_SENDER_POLICY`, without spending an allowance. Retained for back-compat;         prefer `seizeWithMemo` (to a treasury/self address) followed by `burn`.         Emits `Transfer(from, address(0), amount)` and `BurnedBlocked(caller, from, amount)`.

burnWithMemo(uint256,bytes32).notice: Same as `burn`, plus emits `Memo` immediately after the standard `Transfer` event.         A memo of `bytes32(0)` is permitted.

cancelUIMultiplierUpdate().notice: Cancels the single live pending update, restoring the no-pending state         (`effectiveAt` resets to 0).

contractURI().notice: Off-chain URI pointing at contract-level metadata for this token, per ERC-7572.

decimals().notice: Number of decimal places. Immutable per token variant.

effectiveAt().notice: Returns the timestamp at which the pending multiplier becomes effective.

extraMetadata(string).notice: The value of the named metadata entry, or the empty string if not set. A         variant-agnostic key/value store; the issuer chooses the key namespace         (e.g. `"category"`, `"region"`, `"reference"`).

fromUIAmount(uint256).notice: Converts a UI amount back to its raw token amount.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).notice: The role required to grant or revoke `role`. Defaults to `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` if not         explicitly set via `setRoleAdmin`.

hasRole(bytes32,address).notice: Whether `account` is a member of `role`. User-defined roles are supported and have no         built-in effect on the token's own functions.

isAnnouncementIdUsed(string).notice: Whether `id` has previously been consumed by `announce`.

mintWithMemo(address,uint256,bytes32).notice: Same as `mint`, plus emits `Memo` immediately after the standard `Transfer` event.         A memo of `bytes32(0)` is permitted.

multiplier().notice: The current multiplier, scaled to `WAD_PRECISION`. Holder balances are stored         as raw units; the multiplier scales them into a derived "scaled" view, similar         in shape to wstETH wrapping stETH.

name().notice: Token name. Set at creation, mutable via `updateName`.

newUIMultiplier().notice: Returns the pending UI multiplier scheduled to take effect at `effectiveAt`.         Multiplier is represented with 18 decimals (`1e18 = 1.0`).

nonces(address).notice: The current EIP-2612 permit nonce for `owner`. Incremented by 1 on each successful `permit`.

pause(uint8[]).notice: Pauses each of `features`. Additive: features already paused remain paused; duplicates         within the call are idempotent. Emits `Paused`.

pausedFeatures().notice: The `PausableFeature`s currently paused on this token. Order is implementation-defined;         callers should treat the result as a set.

permit(address,address,uint256,uint256,u.notice: EIP-2612 permit. Recovers `owner` via ECDSA from `(v, r, s)`. EOA signatures only;         ERC-1271 contract signatures are NOT supported. Emits `Approval`.

policyId(bytes32).notice: The current policy ID configured for `policyScope`. Returns `0` (always-allow built-in)         for any slot that has never been assigned.

renounceLastAdmin().notice: Permanently transitions the token to a zero-admin state. Revokes `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`         from `msg.sender`. Emits `RoleRevoked(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender, msg.sender)` and         `LastAdminRenounced(msg.sender)`.

seizeWithMemo(address,address,uint256,by.notice: Seizes `amount` of `from`'s balance and reassigns it to `to` in a single admin operation.         Emits, in order, `Transfer(from, to, amount)`, `Memo(caller, memo)`, and         `Seized(caller, from, to, amount)`. A memo of `bytes32(0)` is permitted.

setRoleAdmin(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Sets the admin role for `role`. Emits `RoleAdminChanged`.

supplyCap().notice: The maximum total supply enforced on `mint`. Capped at `type(uint128).max`, which         indicates no cap (the unbounded sentinel). `totalSupply` can therefore never exceed         `type(uint128).max`.

supportsInterface(bytes4).notice: Whether this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`.

symbol().notice: Token symbol. Set at creation, mutable via `updateSymbol`.

toRawBalance(uint256).notice: DEPRECATED. Converts a scaled balance back to its raw representation:         `scaledBalance * WAD_PRECISION / multiplier`. Retained (dialable) for backward         compatibility; prefer the ERC-8056 Conversion extension `fromUIAmount`.

toScaledBalance(uint256).notice: DEPRECATED. Converts a raw balance to its scaled view:         `rawBalance * multiplier / WAD_PRECISION`. Retained (dialable) for backward         compatibility; prefer the ERC-8056 Conversion extension `toUIAmount`.

toUIAmount(uint256).notice: Converts a raw token amount to its UI representation.

totalSupply().notice: Total token supply currently in circulation.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).notice: Transfers `amount` from `from` to `to` using `msg.sender`'s allowance. Emits `Transfer`.

transferFromWithMemo(address,address,uin.notice: Same as `transferFrom`, plus emits `Memo` immediately after the standard `Transfer` event.         A memo of `bytes32(0)` is permitted.

transferWithMemo(address,uint256,bytes32.notice: Same as `transfer`, plus emits `Memo` immediately after the standard `Transfer` event.         A memo of `bytes32(0)` is permitted.

uiMultiplier().notice: Returns the current UI multiplier. Multiplier is represented with 18 decimals (`1e18 = 1.0`).

unpause(uint8[]).notice: Unpauses each of `features`. Features not listed are unaffected; duplicates are idempotent.         Emits `Unpaused`.

updateContractURI(string).notice: Updates `contractURI`. Emits the parameterless `ContractURIUpdated` event per ERC-7572;         integrators re-fetch `contractURI()` after observing it.

updateExtraMetadata(string,string).notice: Sets, updates, or removes an extra-metadata entry. An empty `value` removes the         entry. Emits `ExtraMetadataUpdated`.

updateMultiplier(uint256).notice: DEPRECATED. Instant failsafe / emergency override — sets the current multiplier         immediately and cancels any live pending update without a scheduling window, emitting         both `MultiplierUpdated` and `UIMultiplierUpdated`. Retained (dialable) for backward         compatibility; prefer the scheduled `updateUIMultiplier` for routine corporate actions.

updateName(string).notice: Updates the token's `name`. Emits `NameUpdated` followed by `EIP712DomainChanged`.

updatePolicy(bytes32,uint64).notice: Updates the policy ID assigned to `policyScope`. Takes effect immediately for the next         operation that consults this slot. Emits `PolicyUpdated`.

updateSupplyCap(uint256).notice: Sets a new supply cap. May be raised or lowered freely, but never below current         `totalSupply` and never above `type(uint128).max`. Emits `SupplyCapUpdated`.

updateUIMultiplier(uint256,uint256).notice: Schedules a UI-multiplier update to take effect at `effectiveAt` — the canonical path         for corporate actions (splits, reinvested dividends).
